spec_impact_justification: Restores what FR-01.09 AC10 and AC01 already say: the preview writes nothing before Accept, the branch is on the remote before the PR, the PR targets the real default branch.
description: Changelog release: preview before write (F2/D12), branch push before the PR (F3/D7), default branch from the remote (F5/D24), one merge rule (D8)
